name: Bond of Fauna, Improved (Faunal)
body:
As your bond with nature strengthens, your animal abilities become more instinctive and less taxing to use.

Prerequisite(s): Bond of Fauna, character level 6th

Benefit(s): Your innate gift for animal magic strengthens, allowing you to use your detect animals and speak with animals spell-like abilities at will.

Call of the Wild, Book 1 – The Druid. © 2017 d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Kalen Tessmann
